# Endpoint Inventory Only

Read and update durable state before starting. Discover backend endpoints, filters, interceptors, security configuration, JSP/Struts actions, Express routes/middleware, and frontend API calls/forms/route guards. Resolve each route to a handler and save `.sast-agent/inventory/endpoint-inventory.md` and `.sast-agent/inventory/route-to-handler-map.md`. Do not perform deep vulnerability claims. Save progress after each file, endpoint, controller, and route; finish with a checkpoint and counts. Do not modify application source code.
